sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor's satisfies the recognized-degree route; final award required before enrollment, with
minimum cumulative undergraduate GPA 3.0 unless an exception is approved. International applicants may
apply; select PhD rather than simultaneous MS/PhD applications in the same program. [s3] [s6]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 portal opened October 1, 2026. Choose Physical Sciences / Mathematics / PhD and state research
area; arrange official Math GRE or obtain clarification on the exceptional waiver; confirm pending-degree
English exemption with mathgrad@uci.edu. [s1] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior adviser agreement published. Contact research faculty for fit, without presuming 2027 capacity.
Christopher Davis is Professor of Teaching; establish eligibility/availability before treating him as a primary PhD
adviser. [s1] [s11] [s24]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use apply.grad.uci.edu; incomplete files not reviewed. Submit before outstanding letters/scores if necessary
but meet complete-file deadline. Application content cannot be changed after submission; recommendations
can be monitored. [s3] [s4] [s10]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 central portal explicitly open October 1, 2026. Math complete deadline annual December 1; GRE
exception dates and several department policy passages are inconsistent/stale. [s1] [s2] [s10]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Unless exempt, official TOEFL minimum 80 before January 21, 2026 or 4 afterward; IELTS overall 7 with each
module at least 6. Two-year validity; no MyBest, Essentials or ITP Plus. TA requirements differ: speaking TOEFL
26 old/5 new, IELTS 8, or campus-approved assessment if no exemption. [s3] [s4] [s26]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Central admission exemption covers an earned undergraduate/master's degree whose sole instructional
language is English in WHED; completed UChicago degree should fit, subject to record verification. Treatment
of an in-progress degree is not explicit. Math page instead says US post-baccalaureate degree, conflicting with
central policy. TA exemption separately covers sole-English undergraduate degrees earned within five years
before UCI admission. [s1] [s3] [s7]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Optional to submit; no minimum; official ETS scores code 4859, five-year validity. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Conflict]
Required standing rule, official scores within five years. Exceptional inability-to-test waiver has conflicting
dates: indexed main page says December 2025 applications, live mirror says December 2027. It asks a
paragraph at end of Personal Statement plus future test date to permit submission. Ask whether exception
applies to this December 2026 application before relying on it. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three electronic letters required. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
Not established in the public sources checked; verify this item in the program portal or with graduate
admissions.
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Submitting recommender names/contact information sends automated invitations before the application itself
is submitted. [s3]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
You may submit before letters arrive; central instructions defer final letter timing to the department, whose
complete-file deadline is December 1. [s1] [s3]

electronic system, paper letters not accepted. [s3] [s4]

an already submitted letter. Application itself cannot be changed after submission. [s4]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required. Paraphrased Math prompt: career/research goals, why UCI Math and its faculty fit, and preparation to
become a strong researcher. Exact Math length/format not published on the checked page; the 1,200-word
limits on other UCI departments should be confirmed in the Math portal rather than assumed. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional Personal History Statement. Paraphrased prompt: how educational, family, cultural, financial/social
experiences or challenges motivate the mathematics PhD; optionally contribution to departmental
social/cultural diversity. Math-specific length and formatting not publicly established. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Specify area in the application; discuss research interests and faculty fit in required SOP. No separate
research-interest essay established. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Conflict]
If an authorized Math GRE exception applies, add short inability-to-test explanation at end of Personal
Statement and enter a future test date; the applicable cycle is unresolved. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Exact annual Math stipend for Fall 2027 not publicly established. Department lists TA/GSR/fellowships and
fee/health remissions; its undated residual fee figures (USD 256.50/quarter, 769.50/year) appear old and
should not be treated as 2027 costs. Additional current evidence: the UC contract fixes Group 1
quarter-campus entry TA pay at USD 4,278 per month for a 50% appointment effective October 1, 2027. Nine
paid months would be USD 38,502 gross by arithmetic; this is a salary scale, not a guaranteed department
offer, appointment length, September payment, or summer award. Higher steps depend on qualifying
experience. [s8] [s27]
Years of support [Unresolved]
No current multi-year Math funding guarantee verified. Public department page describes appointments for
some/all academic year and 12 pre-candidacy plus 6 post-candidacy TA-quarter limits, which are employment
caps rather than a funding promise. [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Nonresident tuition fellowships and TA support are available; exact nonresident tuition coverage depends on
award. Public page mentions three-year post-candidacy nonresident tuition reduction; verify current offer
terms. [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Published Math TA workload at 50% is no more than 220 hours/quarter; department assumes no additional
employment and maximum combined university service 50% during sessions. English/TA qualification or
exemption must be satisfied. Current collective agreement may supersede older financial page details. [s7] [s8]

Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Not established in the public sources checked; verify this item in the program portal or with graduate
admissions.
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Department names fellowships, research/teaching assistantships, nonresident tuition awards and grants; exact
competitions, international restrictions and scholarship essays need award-by-award confirmation. [s8]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 155 international; USD 135 US citizen/permanent resident; credit card only, nonrefundable. [s1] [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Central waivers are domestic-only; F1 international applicants are not eligible. Current policy limits qualifying
reasons to listed preparatory programs or veteran status, unlike Math page's older financial-need language.
Eligible applicants submit application/evidence at least five days before program deadline or March 4,
whichever earlier. [s1] [s5]

text:
University of California, Irvine
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• GRE Math is required unless a specifically applicable exception is confirmed.
• Some public department financial figures and English requirements are older than current central policy.
• Annual stipend and guarantee length remain unverified.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor's satisfies the recognized-degree route; final award required before enrollment, with
minimum cumulative undergraduate GPA 3.0 unless an exception is approved. International applicants may
apply; select PhD rather than simultaneous MS/PhD applications in the same program. [s3] [s6]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 portal opened October 1, 2026. Choose Physical Sciences / Mathematics / PhD and state research
area; arrange official Math GRE or obtain clarification on the exceptional waiver; confirm pending-degree
English exemption with mathgrad@uci.edu. [s1] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior adviser agreement published. Contact research faculty for fit, without presuming 2027 capacity.
Christopher Davis is Professor of Teaching; establish eligibility/availability before treating him as a primary PhD
adviser. [s1] [s11] [s24]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use apply.grad.uci.edu; incomplete files not reviewed. Submit before outstanding letters/scores if necessary
but meet complete-file deadline. Application content cannot be changed after submission; recommendations
can be monitored. [s3] [s4] [s10]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 central portal explicitly open October 1, 2026. Math complete deadline annual December 1; GRE
exception dates and several department policy passages are inconsistent/stale. [s1] [s2] [s10]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
December 1 annual complete-file deadline, including supporting documents. No explicit December 2026 year
or cutoff/time zone was verified. Do not treat the page's December 2027 GRE-waiver note as the application
deadline. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No separately dated funding deadline verified; submit complete application by the published December 1 Math
deadline and indicate funding interest as prompted. [s1] [s8]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Central preferred Statement of Intent to Register deadline is April 15; later offers should respond promptly.
This is preferred university guidance, not a verified Fall 2027 Math offer deadline. [s9]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Unless exempt, official TOEFL minimum 80 before January 21, 2026 or 4 afterward; IELTS overall 7 with each
module at least 6. Two-year validity; no MyBest, Essentials or ITP Plus. TA requirements differ: speaking TOEFL
26 old/5 new, IELTS 8, or campus-approved assessment if no exemption. [s3] [s4] [s26]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Central admission exemption covers an earned undergraduate/master's degree whose sole instructional
language is English in WHED; completed UChicago degree should fit, subject to record verification. Treatment
of an in-progress degree is not explicit. Math page instead says US post-baccalaureate degree, conflicting with
central policy. TA exemption separately covers sole-English undergraduate degrees earned within five years
before UCI admission. [s1] [s3] [s7]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Optional to submit; no minimum; official ETS scores code 4859, five-year validity. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Conflict]
Required standing rule, official scores within five years. Exceptional inability-to-test waiver has conflicting
dates: indexed main page says December 2025 applications, live mirror says December 2027. It asks a
paragraph at end of Personal Statement plus future test date to permit submission. Ask whether exception
applies to this December 2026 application before relying on it. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Conflict]
Upload unofficial transcripts from every institution attended after high school, front/back with grading legend,
name and dates. Foreign records need English versions and a US GPA calculation per Math. Math says final
official records from degree institutions; central policy says all postsecondary work, so confirm final-record
scope after admission. [s1] [s3] [s6]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Not established in the public sources checked; verify this item in the program portal or with graduate
admissions.
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three electronic letters required. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
Not established in the public sources checked; verify this item in the program portal or with graduate
admissions.
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Submitting recommender names/contact information sends automated invitations before the application itself
is submitted. [s3]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
You may submit before letters arrive; central instructions defer final letter timing to the department, whose
complete-file deadline is December 1. [s1] [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Portal monitors recommendation status after submission; invitations can be resent. Interfolio accepted through
electronic system, paper letters not accepted. [s3] [s4]

Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Central FAQ requires separate letters for separate programs; no verified reuse across cycles or replacement of
an already submitted letter. Application itself cannot be changed after submission. [s4]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Publications list; Course-list document; Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Not established in the public sources checked; verify this item in the program portal or with graduate
admissions.
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required. Paraphrased Math prompt: career/research goals, why UCI Math and its faculty fit, and preparation to
become a strong researcher. Exact Math length/format not published on the checked page; the 1,200-word
limits on other UCI departments should be confirmed in the Math portal rather than assumed. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional Personal History Statement. Paraphrased prompt: how educational, family, cultural, financial/social
experiences or challenges motivate the mathematics PhD; optionally contribution to departmental
social/cultural diversity. Math-specific length and formatting not publicly established. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Specify area in the application; discuss research interests and faculty fit in required SOP. No separate
research-interest essay established. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Conflict]
If an authorized Math GRE exception applies, add short inability-to-test explanation at end of Personal
Statement and enter a future test date; the applicable cycle is unresolved. [s1] [s2]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Exact annual Math stipend for Fall 2027 not publicly established. Department lists TA/GSR/fellowships and
fee/health remissions; its undated residual fee figures (USD 256.50/quarter, 769.50/year) appear old and
should not be treated as 2027 costs. Additional current evidence: the UC contract fixes Group 1
quarter-campus entry TA pay at USD 4,278 per month for a 50% appointment effective October 1, 2027. Nine
paid months would be USD 38,502 gross by arithmetic; this is a salary scale, not a guaranteed department
offer, appointment length, September payment, or summer award. Higher steps depend on qualifying
experience. [s8] [s27]
Years of support [Unresolved]
No current multi-year Math funding guarantee verified. Public department page describes appointments for
some/all academic year and 12 pre-candidacy plus 6 post-candidacy TA-quarter limits, which are employment
caps rather than a funding promise. [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Nonresident tuition fellowships and TA support are available; exact nonresident tuition coverage depends on
award. Public page mentions three-year post-candidacy nonresident tuition reduction; verify current offer
terms. [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Published Math TA workload at 50% is no more than 220 hours/quarter; department assumes no additional
employment and maximum combined university service 50% during sessions. English/TA qualification or
exemption must be satisfied. Current collective agreement may supersede older financial page details. [s7] [s8]

Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Not established in the public sources checked; verify this item in the program portal or with graduate
admissions.
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Department names fellowships, research/teaching assistantships, nonresident tuition awards and grants; exact
competitions, international restrictions and scholarship essays need award-by-award confirmation. [s8]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 155 international; USD 135 US citizen/permanent resident; credit card only, nonrefundable. [s1] [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Central waivers are domestic-only; F1 international applicants are not eligible. Current policy limits qualifying
reasons to listed preparatory programs or veteran status, unlike Math page's older financial-need language.
Eligible applicants submit application/evidence at least five days before program deadline or March 4,
whichever earlier. [s1] [s5]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
GRE exception says December 2025 vs December 2027 across official versions; English degree waiver
post-baccalaureate vs central undergraduate/master's; TA mandatory speaking wording vs central degree
exemption; final transcripts degree institutions vs all institutions; fee waiver financial need vs current domestic
prep/veteran-only policy. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s5] [s6] [s7]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm deadline year/time and GRE exception with mathgrad@uci.edu; confirm in-progress UChicago English
waiver. Inspect portal for CV/course-list/research/sample/publication fields and actual essay limits. Obtain
written stipend, summer/nonresident tuition/fees, duration and scholarship conditions; letter
replacement/reuse is unresolved. [s1] [s3] [s8]
